title: Jon Gruden and Ronde Barber will call Buccaneers-Chiefs preseason game

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jon Gruden and Ronde Barber will call Buccaneers-Chiefs preseason game
sources.description: Former Buccaneers head coach Jon Gruden and former Buccaneers cornerback Ronde Barber will be sharing a booth for a preseason game next month.
